about: 2026-11-01 attires (data\revport\attires\ATTIRES.md): Scott Steiner's costume 1 of 5 -- Revenge's four: his white singlet with his shades, the same without, the red singlet with his dark hair, the black singlet (WCW/nWo Revenge's costume 1). Look at the select's model, the VS card and him in the ring: the attire and its colours as Revenge's (attires\sheet_scottsteiner.png), head / mask, skin tone, hands / fingers.
